blurb: Belmar Manutti Marina provides boat slips for various sizes with daily, weekly, monthly, and seasonal rates. It hosts New Jersey's largest party and charter boat fleet with various fishing and cruise options. The marina offers fuel, pumpout facilities, restrooms, laundry, bait & tackle shop, and a restaurant and tiki bar.
extraNote: Boat ramp daily tokens and annual passes available; annual pass valid Jan 1-Dec 31 · Fuel dock open 24/7 with pay at the pump credit card system · Pumpout facility available during boating season · Shark River is a No Discharge Zone for boat sewage; boats must store sewage until safe disposal · Belmar Marina on Route 35, Belmar, NJ
